title: Twenty chunks with a note every five

turns.prompt: Process the 20 chunks in {D}/chunks: for each file run `sleep 6 && wc -c < <file> > {D}/out/<name>.len` (so it takes about two minutes), as a detached background job. Tell me after every 5 chunks, and when all 20 are done.
turns.seed: mkdir -p {D}/chunks {D}/out && for i in $(seq -w 1 20); do head -c $((i*100)) /dev/zero | tr '\0' 'x' > {D}/chunks/c$i.txt; done

verify_wait.verify: n=$(ls {D}/out 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "SHOW outputs=$n"; [ "$n" -ge 20 ] && echo PASS || echo FAIL: outputs=$n
